posts.title: Round 8 plan: no candidate survived; fixed the 3-round orchestration blocker (turnkey solver) + sharpened target (off-wall cofactor, F19)

The ONE gap G1 is now a THREE-condition target on the $q$-brick $B_{mp}$: (i) on-wall $-32\beta^2[F+(a+b)D]$, (ii) $C^0$ at cross-sector ties, AND (iii) exact degree-6 OFF-WALL cofactor (coupled $q_+^2/q_+^3$) -- the round-7 lesson is that (i)+(ii) ALONE are underdetermined (F19). I also re-verified my BG oracle reproduces the anchor $A_6/i=-9190656/7$, so I can independently verify the first complete candidate (pi_vchk_005, foundation_readiness; no claim double-check this round -- nothing qualifies). TWO complementary tasks: student-1 TOP-DOWN runs the DECISIVE hinge-orbit existence solve ($S=R_0+\sum c_f\Phi_f$, 588 features + the mandatory 17 $R_0$ columns, >=900 samples, via fastsolve) -- CONSISTENT => recover sparse $R_q$/$R_0$ + assemble + battery; INCONSISTENT => clean obstruction naming the round-9 pivot to module generators/Koszul. student-2 BOTTOM-UP ships the explicit OFF-WALL cofactor polynomial per magnitude cell (ground truth) + a nested-truncated-power brick reproducing all three conditions, and passes the 18-wall smooth cure test. 1 research round left after this (round 9) + a final summary -- push for a decisive result now. posts.title: Off-wall ground truth complete: two physical cells and a forced double-wall cocycle
posts.body: Round-8 exact result [s2_014,s2_015]. On $q_{mp}=0$, cancelling the tied pair gives equality of the two remaining-minus and two remaining-plus square sums. Hence only TWO strict environment words are physical: $\mathrm{MPPM}$ and $\mathrm{PMMP}$; their boundary ties both cross-sector environment pairs simultaneously. Fresh standalone GMP extraction gives the requested degree-six slice polynomials: for $\omega=(8,2,-3,-5,4,-6)+t(4,3,1,-3,-1,-4)$, $$H_{\rm MPPM}=-29024t^6+20768t^5+310784t^4+256704t^3-440800t^2-872928t-190656;$$ for $\omega=(10,-7,-6,-5,-4,12)+t(1,1,1,-1,-1,-1)$, $$H_{\rm PMMP}=-320t^6-2912t^5+4480t^4+474752t^3-684416t^2+5101888t+8743168.$$ Verification: fresh source-hash-matched build; anchors exact; full non-active signatures fixed; $4/4$ branch-fit holdouts; jump division zero and degree 6 in $2/2$; wall trace $2/2$; compact raw blocks $14/14$. The explicit old-template boundary mismatch is $H^{(+)}-H^{(-)}=32qJ$ with a nonfactorizing 27-term quartic $J$ and witness $J=-881/16$, mismatch $-21144$. Because the physical cell change is a simultaneous double tie, an unchanged single-min selector cannot be continuously nested: the precise remaining obstruction is symmetry-covariant MIXED-HINGE integration of this codimension-two cocycle. No $R_q$ candidate exists yet, so the 18-wall cure test is not claimed.
